<div class="req-card" id="L_Lenk_6219" data-type="Anforderung" data-search="L_Lenk_6219 For safety-relevant systems, four release levels 1 – 4 are defined. The definition of the release level is derived from the application purpose. The release level illustrates the safety maturity of the system. For this purpose, the following criteria are used: 1.) The area of application and/or the use of the sample level at Volkswagen. 2.) Qualification of the driver The lower release levels are the prerequisite for higher release levels. <div class="req-head"><code>L_Lenk_6219</code> <span class="badge badge-type" title="Anforderung"><code>Anforderung</code> · requirement</span> <span class="badge badge-valid ok" title="DE: gültig">valid</span> <span class="badge">VW: to evaluate</span> <span class="badge">Supplier: to clarify</span></div>

For safety-relevant systems, four release levels 1 – 4 are defined.
The definition of the release level is derived from the application purpose. The release level illustrates the safety maturity of the system.
For this purpose, the following criteria are used:

1.)	The area of application and/or the use of the sample level at Volkswagen.

2.)	Qualification of the driver

The lower release levels are the prerequisite for higher release levels. As a consequence, each higher release level includes the areas of application and the requirements of the respective lower release level. This relationship between higher and lower release level must be complied with during use of the manual.

|---|---|

| Status VW | to evaluate |
| Status supplier | to clarify |

<div class="req-card" id="L_Lenk_5913" data-type="Information" data-search="L_Lenk_5913 In the case of silicon-containing materials (sealings, adhesives, casting compounds, cooling pads, etc.), it should be noted that existing low molecular siloxanes (cyclic siloxanes D4*-D8) can diffuse (gases) from the material and affect electrical contacts. Under the influence of electrical/thermal energy (contact sparks, brush fire, nerve probes (lambda/NOx sensors) etc.) the siloxane can be degraded, which then isolates the contact by oxidizing the contact. The silicone ejections can be reduced to a minimum by previous heat treatment (temperatures) of the material. *D4-octamethylcyclotetrasiloxanes Information gültig accepted agreed information valid MT machine-translated">

In the case of silicon-containing materials (sealings, adhesives, casting compounds, cooling pads, etc.), it should be noted that existing low molecular siloxanes (cyclic siloxanes D4*-D8) can diffuse (gases) from the material and affect electrical contacts. Under the influence of electrical/thermal energy (contact sparks, brush fire, nerve probes (lambda/NOx sensors) etc.) the siloxane can be degraded, which then isolates the contact by oxidizing the contact. The silicone ejections can be reduced to a minimum by previous heat treatment (temperatures) of the material.
*D4-octamethylcyclotetrasiloxanes

**Storage error:**
The term "storage error" generally refers to static and dynamic memory error types.

- Static memory errors are e.g. address decoder errors, stucco-at errors (SAF), stucco-open errors (SOF), transient errors (TF), coupling errors (CF), etc.
- Dynamic errors are e.g. recovery errors, disturb errors, data retention errors, etc.
